## Summary:
Forward declared `apache::thrift::syntax_graph::FunctionNode` and moved `SyntaxGraph.h` include from header files to implementation files in both fbcode and xplat directories. This reduces include bloat by ~902KB per compilation unit that includes LazyDynamicArguments.h.

Changes:
- `fbcode/thrift/lib/cpp2/server/LazyDynamicArguments.h` and `xplat/thrift/lib/cpp2/server/LazyDynamicArguments.h`: Added forward declaration of `FunctionNode` and removed `SyntaxGraph.h` include
- `fbcode/thrift/lib/cpp2/server/LazyDynamicArguments.cpp` and `xplat/thrift/lib/cpp2/server/LazyDynamicArguments.cpp`: Added `SyntaxGraph.h` include
- BUCK files updated to move `syntax_graph` dependency from `exported_deps` to regular `deps`
